nodes.text: You listened. Nobody listens. Eleven sticks in spring and nineteen at midsummer, and every one of them a great one. Go and ask Groa whether a log can walk off her floor. She will say no. I want somebody who is not me to hear her say it.

choices.text: That is the reeve's work, not mine.

nodes.text: Wet count at the boom, dry count at the deck. Hold both numbers in your head while you talk to her. That is the whole trick.
It is. She has not asked. Nineteen years and she has not asked once.
